title: The Daily Five
dek: Five questions on Israeli sport, from a 2009 Davis Cup classic to this weekend's Ligat Ha'al and MLS action.

questions.question: Which Maccabi Tel Aviv player scored a hat-trick — including a first-half stoppage-time penalty — in a 5-2 win over Hapoel Jerusalem to open the 2026/27 Ligat Ha'al season?
questions.explanation: Dor Peretz scored a hat-trick, including a first-half stoppage-time penalty, for his first Israeli top-flight treble.

questions.question: Who became owner and chairman leading the newly merged operation of Ramat Gan's men's and women's top-division basketball clubs?
questions.explanation: Avi Gabai, who became owner and chairman of Maccabi Ironi Ramat Gan last season, now leads the merged men's and women's operation.

questions.question: Who clinched Israel's 3-0 Davis Cup quarterfinal win over Russia in Tel Aviv by winning the deciding doubles rubber on 11 July 2009?
questions.explanation: Ram and Erlich beat Safin and Kunitsyn 6-3, 6-4, 6-7(3-7), 4-6, 6-4 in doubles to seal the 3-0 tie, sending Israel to its first-ever Davis Cup semifinal.

questions.question: Which MLS club signed Israeli forward Dor Turgeman from Maccabi Tel Aviv in August 2025 for about $6 million plus bonuses?
questions.explanation: New England signed Turgeman from Maccabi Tel Aviv in August 2025 via the MLS U22 Initiative, reportedly for about $6 million plus $1 million in bonuses.

questions.question: In Barcelona's 5-0 La Liga-opening win at Elche, which player scored twice, including a 14th-minute penalty?
questions.explanation: Raphinha scored twice, including a 14th-minute penalty and a goal in the 67th minute, in Barcelona's 5-0 win at Elche.
